item.title: Metasequoia Avenue: Makino's Dawn-Redwood Tunnel — Guide
item.description: The Metasequoia Avenue in Makino, on Lake Biwa’s northwestern edge, is one of Japan’s most photographed tree-lined roads: some 500 metasequoia (dawn redwood) trees march dead-straight for 2.4 kilometres across open farmland toward the mountains, their tall conical crowns meeting overhead in a soaring green tunnel. Planted as a windbreak in the 1980s and now grown magnificent, the avenue transforms with the seasons — fresh green in spring, deep shade in summer, a blaze of coppery russet in late November, and a monochrome corridor after winter snow — and is regularly named among Japan’s most beautiful streets.
